events.summary: Delivery Survivors is joining Steam Bullet Fest! Add us to your wishlist now. We plan to update the game with some new content during the festival, so you can get the latest information first-hand.

events.title: Massive Content Update — Playtest 0.0.6a
events.summary: This Playtest 0.0.6 update includes the following additions and changes:New weaponsAdded the “Remove Weapon Service” feature in shopNew charactersSave system improvementsGame balance adjustmentsSteam achievements addedAdditional settings and customization options, including keybindingsVarious bug fixesVersion 0.0.6a is a hotfix for a UI visual bug. Playtest will continue to be updated in the future.The demo is scheduled for release in Q2 2026.

events.title: Playtest Live Now!
events.summary: Hello everyone!The 0.0.2 playtest is now live! Version 0.0.1 was originally created for the web build on itch.io, while 0.0.2 mainly adds a few simple settings to make playing on Windows more convenient.The current playtest includes:1 Character18 Weapons25 Relics2 MapsDemo is currently in the works and is planned to release around May–June.Thanks for playing and supporting the game!
